div.div:
Represents mass spectrum acquired at a point-in-time. This may include ion mobility as an additional dimension, but the detected signal is primarily sorted on m/z. It may contain both profile and centroid data for the same spectrum. The hierarchical layout records precursor/product relationships,
Main Axis: m/z array

div.div: A listing of all the files with associated metadata, as well as shared metadata that is shared amongst all files in the archive. This file coordinates all other files in the archive, and provides a starting point for reading. Any kind of file may be included in the archive as long as it is listed in the index and tagged appropriately. This also stores checksums for doing basic integrity checking.
